Article 7 (Submission of Financial Statements and Business Reports)
① In accordance with Article 44 of the Act, the association must submit its financial statements and business reports to the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries within 3 months after the end of the fiscal year. <Amended March 24, 2013>
② The format and accounting standards for the financial statements referred to in Article 1 of this Act shall be as determined by the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries. <Amended March 24, 2013>
③ The business report required by Article 1 must include the following information:
1. General overview of the business
2. If the changes to the items listed in Article 15 of the Act, paragraph 3 have been approved in accordance with Article 15 of the Act, paragraph 3, the approved items
3. Information regarding the holding of the general meeting and the agenda
4. Information regarding the holding of the board of directors and the agenda
5. Information regarding the establishment or change of the branch office
6. Information regarding changes in members and associate members
7. Business performance
